# Donation Drive - Stone to Sandmoon Village

## Post 160607 by Mistermadigan — 2025-11-25T01:56:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160607#p160607 | page 1 | era: 1.18.1-announced-pre-release -->

Greetings Richmon.  I be Kachina, Sandfury Exile of <The Blackrock Clan>.  It seems like just yesterday that da big Chief Ukroz Sandscalp drove out those what be opposing his misuse of ancient magics and sacrificing of prisoners to dark powers.  What few survived the exile found no refuge in the Goblin city of Gadgetzan, instead taking up residence at the ruins of Sandmoon Village under the leadership of Taza'go, Champion of da free Sandfury Trolls.
![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxgz3-17c9da52-2e79-42e8-8047-9512a00d3a9f.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/kachina1_by_mistermadigan_dkyxgz3-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..bO9vindPvKfucGL_j8ASCkqkFHPQn8OhPaO8OzuIJHQ)

Now, I not be saying it's all bad.  We know the ways of the sand and with cunning, skill, and courage - we've built a home in the old ruins.  And while we plot to rebuild our strength, plot our revenge, and seek allies in our fight - we know it's not just enough to "Survive" - we must thrive and grow as a people, or else we die with our fallen city.
![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxgyp-a0fd482b-3e36-4e87-9b5c-5302c66507c6.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/kachina2_by_mistermadigan_dkyxgyp-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..hc9xqIxAKdo7QC0DK9aS20mdEfT5pzplUPxs3k5zAk8)
 - Now, don't be worrying about our cages, those be old cages and old bones what belong to some wastewanders and pirates what thought they could extort and threaten us.  We be enough to handle dem.

Me best friend at Sandmoon be Ekka, keeper of the Dread Scorpion - Viceclaw.  Him be a hungry little fella, a powerful ally once he reaches his full strength... which is what gets me thinkin'.  It's not enough to just exist in the sands on our own, being driven from our homes does not mean we have lost the strength and spirit of our people.
![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxgxy-c507de28-47c7-4993-8926-c870317d7bd8.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/kachina3_by_mistermadigan_dkyxgxy-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..g0lxtGbsdZE14IJgrVjYpoTFbizRd1J47g-c4bY4wCg)

So, me go seeking the advice of Seer Maz'ek to learn what is to be done.
 - Da first task 'im give me was to join da Horde and gain strength to fight our enemies.  That has taken me some time, but finally I became strong enough to return to da Tribe.
 - Second, 'im 'ave me commune with da spirits.  Dere be powerful Loa who do not 'ave a place in Zul'Ferrak dat we could call upon to empower us.
 - Third, we gotta find a place for and then build a temple for da Loa to reside in.  And dis - dis be the part of the process that me gonna be needed da most help for.
![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxgwn-8971163b-3d9b-476d-9b42-ad6c3b668ebb.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/kachina6_by_mistermadigan_dkyxgwn-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..sM4UM0j5WqU6uKr9aPgJ-9FylIlu4D4RKNGwsHGETC4)

Our first Temple site be 'ere, up against the eastern cliff.  Dis might be a good place for a temple to Kimbul - da Tiger Loa.  Dere be plenty-a meat can be brought up from da sea to offa to 'im.
![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxgxk-3848cb57-7a8b-4a7a-86bb-b71de0593242.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/kachina4_by_mistermadigan_dkyxgxk-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..wbBRyu_A91maI5PiA4TXjREJLEKX6r9cAUv3x2iGdWE)

![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxjjk-0e2ae85d-4ff2-4ff2-8481-40d8758a84fa.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_80,strp/kachina7_by_mistermadigan_dkyxjjk-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..vl5d3R09F_8kI3Jih44a2Zl8CkQnQ0oMyOo5fO1zE4g)

Just to the west of Sandmoon Village be dis spot - and overlooking the Shimmering Flats, it make me wonder whether dere be a Basilisk Loa.  Perhaps Sul'lithuz be more than da name for the type of Basilisks in da region - but mebbe the name of dere powerful Loa parent.
![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxgx6-7de2bafc-3f8e-4acf-8616-dc96e4d3aabe.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/kachina5_by_mistermadigan_dkyxgx6-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Y49W3WYt1DipTXnaHo2kSigYtpIqvY6MiUiuyC3cxzQ)

![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/21337f5f-162d-430c-93e9-6d514f52a4c4/dkyxjjg-0790028f-329b-4d7f-b92e-29b41fc2e2f7.png/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_80,strp/kachina8_by_mistermadigan_dkyxjjg-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..z8B8iO5k4da65ulIKh0g7UIfkJQfyhy9gPWGr4fRPTs)

Now dis be all well and good in theory.  Me no be anyone of importance - but if we were to start a donation drive for Sandmoon Village - collecting 10,000 Solid Stone and 4,000 Turtle Meat - perhaps we could have what is needed to build one of these temples and consecrate it to a powerful Loa who could watch over the southern deserts.  It be just a thought - but the world turns on such thoughts.
